[[Liilirsi (world)|Liilirsi]], a world in the [[Kaggushus]] System, is a private fief of the [[Hauptmann Corporation]], a business venture of several local noble families. 

== Description / Astrography & Planetology == 
It is a private facility off limits to uninvited guests, with a pair of old patrol cruisers to guarantee security.
